_comment: Base config for the ESEC Assistant. install_context.py fills guild_id, ask_channel_id, channels and ledger_path and writes ~/.esec-discord-context/esec-assistant.json; setup_assistant.ps1 -ConfigTemplate uses that file. No secrets here.
project_about: ESEC case competition team (Team 6). Case: improving burglary investigations for the Cascade City Police Department; technical judge Guy Ernest (AI-on-Cloud). Check Discord for confirmed logistics (deadlines, pitch slot) rather than assuming them.
team_protocol: Case Comp Research (bot id 1568109550358241361) is the team's Codex research agent; it posts research, proposals and numbers with sources in #resource and #general. Treat its posts as proposals, not decisions. A proposal is a team decision only when it is recorded in #decisions or at least two human teammates explicitly agree (replies or approving reactions); say which proposals are still waiting. #decisions is authoritative over older chat. Your own earlier replies in #ask-bot are not sources. Meeting transcripts and other files are attachments (mostly in #resource): use list_resources and read_attachment before saying something isn't recorded.
